quote: Any person operating a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter shall obey the instructions of official traffic-control signals, signs and other control devices applicable to vehicles, unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer.

activation.condition: A person operates a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter at an applicable official traffic-control device.

obligation.description: Obey official traffic-control signals, signs, and devices applicable to vehicles.

exceptions.effect: The operator follows the Police Officer's contrary direction.
exceptions.source_clause: unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer

timing.description: Observe applicable control and any officer direction before crossing the device station.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: no contrary direction or contrary direction

parameter_refs.name: observed_officer_direction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original visible instruction and response, unresolved
